definitions.explanation: Activities and communications aimed at promoting a positive image of an organization to the public.

notes:
{広報|こうほう} covers both corporate public relations and government public information dissemination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広報|こうほう}⟦{部|ぶ}→部：00440_bu⟧: PR department
- {広報|こうほう}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: PR activities
- {広報|こうほう}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: PR representative/person in charge of PR
- {広報|こうほう}⟦{誌|し}→誌：noentry⟧: public information magazine/newsletter
- {広報|こうほう}⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: spokesperson

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧: advertising, promotion (more sales-oriented)
- ⟦{告知|こくち}→告知：17348_kokuchi⟧: public notice, announcement
- ⟦ピーアール→ピーアール：07749_piiaaru⟧ (PR): public relations (used interchangeably in business)

USAGE:
In a corporate setting, {広報|こうほう} focuses on building a positive image through media relations and communication. In government contexts, it refers to informing citizens through newsletters ({広報|こうほう}⟦{誌|し}→誌：noentry⟧) and public announcements.
